definitions.explanation: The state of being tired or weary, physically or mentally.

examples.english: I can't shake off the fatigue.

examples.japanese: {一日|いちにち}の{疲|つか}れを{癒|いや}す。
examples.english: Relieve the fatigue of the day.

examples.japanese: {疲|つか}れが{顔|かお}に{出|で}ている。
examples.english: The tiredness shows on your face.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{疲|つか}れが{取|と}れる (fatigue goes away, to feel refreshed)
・{疲|つか}れが{出|で}る (fatigue shows, to start feeling tired)
・{疲|つか}れを{癒|いや}す (to relieve fatigue)
・{疲|つか}れを{感|かん}じる (to feel tired)

COMMON COMPOUND WORDS:
・{目|め}の{疲|つか}れ (eye strain)
・{精神的|せいしんてき}{疲|つか}れ (mental fatigue)
・{肉体的|にくたいてき}{疲|つか}れ (physical fatigue)

RELATED VERB:
・{疲|つか}れる (to get tired) - this noun is derived from the verb
